title: Side Hustle & Freelance Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=freelance:invoice) OR (index=personal sourcetype=freelance:hours)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="freelance:invoice","primary",sourcetype="freelance:hours","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from freelance:invoice and freelance:hours to see whether two side hustle feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `freelance:invoice` and `freelance:hours` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main side hustle data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
